manual_pass.reason: Lead accepts every finished or stopped run as a valid result (2026-11-16)

interview.hardest_part: Precise combat and platforming, especially the Moss Mother fight, with screenshot-only 0.4-second input steps and no dash early on.
interview.likely_failure: Most likely failing at Moss Mother or earlier environmental hazards/navigation, preventing even the first 20-point milestone; later Bell Beast, Widow, act two, and an ending are much less likely.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Respawn at benches with persistent progress, silk healing/binding, simple movement and attack controls, and the ability to retry encounters many times within the three-hour budget.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Contact damage, limited masks, no dash initially, boss timing and pattern memorization, large navigational rooms, and the slow discrete 0.4-second action cadence with gameplay continuing while thinking.
